title: Decision Practice
subtitle: Stop & Decide prompts to build active clinical judgment
howToUse: These decision points interrupt passive reading and force active thinking. For each scenario, pause and write your response. Then compare with the model response. Focus on (1) the immediate risk, (2) the safest first nursing action, and (3) what data you must check next.

decisions.title: Medication storage safety
decisions.scenario: While preparing medications, a nurse notices several medications stored in the medication room without proper labeling. Some containers look similar, increasing the risk of medication selection errors.
prompts: Your first action
Your reason (what risk are you preventing?)
What you will check next (one key assessment)

decisions.title: Fire safety
decisions.scenario: A faint smell of smoke is detected coming from a patient room. When the door is opened slightly, smoke is visible, and the source of the smoke is unknown.
prompts: Your first action
Your reason (what risk are you preventing?)
What you will check next (one key assessment)
decisions.modelFirst: Activate fire alarm and follow fire safety protocol.

decisions.title: Oxygen safety
decisions.scenario: A patient receiving supplemental oxygen via nasal cannula is found smoking in bed. The oxygen tubing is still in place, and a lighter is visible in the patient’s hand.
prompts: Your first action
Your reason (what risk are you preventing?)
What you will check next (one key assessment)
decisions.modelFirst: Stop the activity and remove ignition source.
